name: The Silent Belt
flavor: A sparse, eerie debris field. Barely any Hollow signature — an easy first sector to clear.

name: Verdant Ring Remnant
flavor: The greenhouse rings still turn, feeding on dead light. Rebuild this one and it will feed a thousand worlds.

name: Ashfall Remnant
flavor: A scorched industrial belt. Foundries still standing, if you can clear the Hollow out of them.

name: The Drowned Reach
flavor: Flooded ice-worlds under a dead sky. The Hollow nest in the deep trenches here.

name: Kethari Deep
flavor: Off the same trade lanes as Keth Station, but far less policed — and far more contested.

name: Halcyon Remnant Expanse
flavor: The ruins of a corporate empire that thought its light would never go out. It did.

name: Obsidian Frontier
flavor: Wrecked hulls lashed into a pirate haven, half-swallowed by Hollow growth. High risk, high reward.

name: The Frostbound Marches
flavor: A frozen frontier where the Hollow move slow but never stop coming.

name: The Hollow Deep
flavor: Deep space where the dark never lifted at all. The Hollow are entrenched, not just passing through.

name: The Umbral Rift
flavor: The deepest known Hollow incursion. Clearing this would be a name people remember.
